answer: Operator hardware lease audit. Each identity must map to a unique signed device lease held by its operator, with a quartz oscillator providing challenge timing. Random liveness checks verify the lease is present and not shared. A failed check freezes the operator’s whole lease quota and reclaims devices. Deployments in tundra use the same rule. Karst sites do too. Per identity, an attacker must buy and maintain one physical device lease plus absorb quota-loss risk across all its identities.
